pr_title: chore(test runner): rebase watch mode onto TestServerConnection
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/32076.

This PR rewrites `watchMode.ts` to use `TestServer` under the hood. It's essentially a complete rewrite, so don't pay too much attention on the old implementation. Note that there's no changes to tests, so all behaviour we have specced out there still works.

To make this work without a superfluous WebSocket connection, I had to refactor `TestServerConnection` a little. Originally, I pulled this into a [separate PR](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/pull/32132), but then realised how small the refactoring is. So it's in this PR now. Let me know if you'd like to land it separately.

issue_context.title: Rewrite `PWTEST_WATCH` as consumer of TestServer
issue_context.body: Lots of folks are asking for a CLI watch mode, see https://github.com/microsoft/playwright/issues/21960. We're interested in landing it, but for maintainability reasons first we need to rewrite it onto the existing `TestServer`.

review_comments: this is entirely untested, and ideally i'd like to add a test for it - but i'm not sure how to do it best. I tried writing a demo page that reads from `localStorage` across the two test runs, but that gets cleared. how could we assert that a browser is reused?
I'd not worry about testing this piece for now.
Won't this be a truncated list after we run `listTests()` with a project filter once? I think `teleSuiteUpdater.config.projects` is a better source.

Generally yes, but it seems like `config.projects` is empty. We don't send it over here: https://github.com/Skn0tt/playwright/blob/000e0574e50158786dcbac60f893dd2eb334a914/packages/playwright/src/reporters/teleEmitter.ts#L156-L164

I'm not sure what the right solution is. We could use the projects from our initial `listTests` call, but then we'd need to remove the filters from that. Would probably be fine.

Alternatively, we could update `TeleEmitter` et al to transmit the projects in `onConfigure`.

> I'm not sure what the right solution is. We could use the projects from our initial `listTests` call, but then we'd need to remove the filters from that. Would probably be fine.

This sounds like the easiest solution for now.

We can probably update `TeleEmitter` to include projects, but this needs to be done carefully to make sure merger is ok, in a follow up PR.
oh no, I had an update to `listTests` typed but not committed before merging 🤦 gonna work on that refactor next
